notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Balance changes:
1. Reworked all generators power values. Now every generator has it's own base power which means higher income with every unlocked world and generator.
2. Updated generators upgrade prices to match the new increased income.

For current players a single prestige restart is required to apply changes.

Bugs:
Fixed bug with completion "Tiles" and "Evolved" stats after the prestige restart is done.
